finding: Compact event predictor uses field/word/page/current-byte context; source omission of previous-event type is not evidence that another context key improves coding. Existing artifacts retain arithmetic/probability hashes and checkpoints, not recoverable event sequences.
interpretation: Arithmetic operations include literal bits and operands; they cannot be presented as opcode frequencies or transition evidence.
decision: Instrument parent event opportunities before proposing a predictive mutation.

implementation_assignment.scope: New external observer and tiny synthetic tests only; no corpus reexecution or prediction change.

invariants: Preserve parent probabilities,parse,archives,existing audit and state
Independent encoder/decoder event records must match
Do not inspect validation/confirmation to select contexts
next_gate: Only after synthetic P/K identity, exact inverse/repeat and event-witness agreement, freeze a decode-only development archive observation using retained P.arc. This review grants no corpus launch or scientific promotion.
